name: SIA finger-twist robot
full_name: SIA master-slave vascular interventional robot with bionic finger-twisting guidewire mechanism
group: Shenyang Institute of Automation, CAS, State Key Laboratory of Robotics (Hao Liu, Tianyu Zhang, Peng Lin, Liming Zheng, Xiao He) with General Hospital of Northern Theater Command (Ximei Zhao, Jing Qiu); 2022 leader device with Shenyang Jianzhu University
versions: 2022 master manipulator with force feedback (li2022_design, title/affiliations); 2025 slave with bionic finger twisting mechanism + force-based occlusion detection (zhang2025_obstruction, full); 2024: SIA (Hao Liu, Peng Lin) flexible-belt constrained catheterization robot: guidewire in a lumen of two magnet-joined belts pulled by friction rollers, rear-end clamp twists, bench delivery error <= 1.5 mm at 75-125 mm belt spacing (Tian 2024 ICMA; Alekseeva 2025 Table 10 row 4, Fig. 11e) (tian2024_flexbelt; alekseeva2025_design); 2017: SIA (A. Gao, H. Liu) with the General Hospital of Shenyang Command, contact-aided asymmetric tendon-driven ablation catheter (2.6 mm): tendons pulled by a motorised lead screw for the bench bending tests, left-atrium phantom reached by manual tendon, rotation and insertion (Gao 2017 RA-L) (Alekseeva 2025 Table 14 row 7) (gao2017_contactaided; alekseeva2025_design)
devices_driven: guidewire (twisted and advanced) and catheter (clamped by a solenoid valve) (zhang2025_obstruction Sec. IV-A)
n_dof_detail: 2 (axial delivery + rotation; displacement and rotation-angle mapping, zhang2025_obstruction Sec. III)
force_sensing: proximal: two force sensors on the twisting mechanism for axial force and radial torque (zhang2025_obstruction Sec. II-A)
haptics_leader: master handle with two motors and high-precision encoders rendering axial force and radial torque (zhang2025_obstruction Sec. II-A)
validation_detail: 40 interventions in a vascular model; occlusion detected in 36 (zhang2025_obstruction Sec. IV-B)
key_numbers: occlusion detection 90% (36/40); axial force RMSE 414.15 mN; radial torque error 1.01 N·m as printed (torque traces are in mN·m); sampling 1 kHz (zhang2025_obstruction Abstract, Sec. IV-A)
